newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Freight Links to raise up to $90.9 mln.
newsitem.headline: Freight Links to raise up to $90.9 mln.

text.p: Freight Links Express Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it is proposing a one-for-four bonus issue and a two-for-one renounceable rights issue.
The company said in a statement it plans to raise net proceeds of between Singapore $88.8 million and S$90.9 million from its rights issue.
The company said it was planning to issue a maximum of 38.38 million bonus shares and a maximum of 307 million rights shares.

Freight Links said the proposed bonus issue was to reward shareholders in view of the group's good performance for the financial year ended April 30, 1996, and for the half-year ended October 31, 1996.
It said the bonus issue would also serve to increase the capital base of the company in line with its plans for continuing growth and expansion.
The company plans to use funds from the rights issue to reduce bank borrowings for its various ventures as well as for working capital.
DBS Bank had been appointed to manage and underwrite the proposed rights issue, it said.
